name: Employees on Disciplinary Action
report_script:
# Report: Employees on Disciplinary Action
# Type: Script Report



def execute(filters=None):
    columns = get_columns()
    data = get_data(filters)
    return columns, data

def get_columns():
    return [
        {
            "fieldname": "employee",
            "label": _("Employee ID"),
            "fieldtype": "Link",
            "options": "Employee",
            "width": 120
        },
        {
            "fieldname": "employee_name",
            "label": _("Employee Name"),
            "fieldtype": "Data",
            "width": 180
        },
        {
            "fieldname": "department",
            "label": _("Department"),
            "fieldtype": "Link",
            "options": "Department",
            "width": 150
        },
        {
            "fieldname": "case_id",
            "label": _("Case ID"),
            "fieldtype": "Link",
            "options": "Disciplinary",
            "width": 120
        },
        {
            "fieldname": "offence_category",
            "label": _("Offence Category"),
            "fieldtype": "Data",
            "width": 180
        },
        {
            "fieldname": "specific_offence",
            "label": _("Specific Offence"),
            "fieldtype": "Link",
            "options": "Offence Master",
            "width": 200
        },
        {
            "fieldname": "breach_number",
            "label": _("Breach #"),
            "fieldtype": "Data",
            "width": 100
        },
        {
            "fieldname": "prescribed_sanction",
            "label": _("Sanction"),
            "fieldtype": "Data",
            "width": 180
        },
        {
            "fieldname": "workflow_state",
            "label": _("Status"),
            "fieldtype": "Data",
            "width": 150
        },
        {
            "fieldname": "warning_expiry_date",
            "label": _("Warning Expires"),
            "fieldtype": "Date",
            "width": 120
        },
        {
            "fieldname": "is_active",
            "label": _("Warning Active"),
            "fieldtype": "Data",
            "width": 100
        },
        {
            "fieldname": "salary_withheld",
            "label": _("Salary Withheld"),
            "fieldtype": "Data",
            "width": 120
        }
    ]

def get_data(filters):
    conditions = get_conditions(filters)
    
    data = frappe.db.sql(f"""
        SELECT 
            d.employee,
            d.employee_name,
            d.department,
            d.name as case_id,
            d.offence_category,
            d.specific_offence,
            d.breach_number,
            d.prescribed_sanction,
            d.workflow_state,
            d.warning_expiry_date,
            CASE 
                WHEN d.warning_expiry_date >= CURDATE() THEN 'Yes'
                WHEN d.warning_expiry_date IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
                ELSE 'Expired'
            END as is_active,
            CASE 
                WHEN d.prescribed_sanction LIKE '%Suspension%' 
                     AND d.workflow_state IN ('Final Decision', 'Pending CEO Approval')
                THEN 'Yes'
                ELSE 'No'
            END as salary_withheld
        FROM 
            `tabDisciplinary` d
        WHERE 
            d.docstatus != 2
            AND d.workflow_state NOT IN ('Closed', 'Case Closed', 'Cleared')
            {conditions}
        ORDER BY 
            d.creation DESC
    """, as_dict=1)
    
    return data

def get_conditions(filters):
    conditions = ""
    
    if filters.get("employee"):
        conditions += f" AND d.employee = '{filters.get('employee')}'"
    
    if filters.get("department"):
        conditions += f" AND d.department = '{filters.get('department')}'"
    
    if filters.get("offence_category"):
        conditions += f" AND d.offence_category = '{filters.get('offence_category')}'"
    
    if filters.get("show_suspended_only"):
        conditions += " AND d.prescribed_sanction LIKE '%Suspension%'"
    
    if filters.get("show_active_warnings_only"):
        conditions += " AND d.warning_expiry_date >= CURDATE()"
    
    return conditions

name: Active Employee Warnings
query:
SELECT
    d.employee              AS "Employee:Link/Employee:110",
    d.employee_name         AS "Name:Data:170",
    d.name                  AS "Case:Link/Disciplinary:120",
    dc.specific_offence     AS "Offence:Data:200",
    dc.breach_number        AS "Breach:Data:85",
    dc.prescribed_sanction  AS "Sanction:Data:170",
    d.custom_closed_on      AS "Issued On:Date:95",
    dc.warning_expiry_date  AS "Expires On:Date:95",
    DATEDIFF(dc.warning_expiry_date, CURDATE()) AS "Days Left:Int:80"
FROM `tabDisciplinary Charges` dc
INNER JOIN `tabDisciplinary` d ON d.name = dc.parent
WHERE d.workflow_state = 'Case Closed'
  AND dc.warning_expiry_date IS NOT NULL
  AND dc.warning_expiry_date >= CURDATE()
ORDER BY d.employee_name, dc.warning_expiry_date
